queries.all19974_CR_identities: SELECT node_id,tdocNumber FROM CR ORDER BY tdocNumber,node_id
queries.all353_target_paths: SELECT cr.node_id,cr.tdocNumber,cr.summaryOfChange,e.edge_id,e.rel_type,e.dst_id,sp.specNumber FROM CR cr JOIN edge e ON cr.node_id=e.src_id JOIN Spec sp ON sp.node_id=e.dst_id WHERE e.rel_type IN ('AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC','AFFECTS_TEST_SPEC','AFFECTS_OM_SPEC') AND sp.specNumber='38.473' ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber DESC,e.edge_id
